guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the Olympus Aptos claim page
guide.description: Go to the Olympus Aptos page . The claim tab sits directly on the dashboard.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect your wallet
guide.description: Use a wallet such as Petra or Pontem. Approve the connection request when it pops up.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund your wallet with a small amount of APT
guide.description: You need APT to cover gas plus the $0.20 anti-sybil fee per claim. You can buy APT on Bybit and withdraw it straight to your Aptos address. If you also plan to use Olympus on its other chains, the widget below lets you bridge or swap funds to the network you need. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim your pOmega and the NFT
guide.description: Open the Claim tab, tap Claim pOmega, and confirm the transaction. You receive 100 pOmega per claim, and early Aptos users get the exclusive NFT on top.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade and predict on the dashboard
guide.description: Put your pOmega to work. Place predictions on open markets, swap tokens, or create a market of your own. Activity across the app is what the quest campaigns track.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Repeat claims during the beta
guide.description: Claims are not capped, so return regularly and claim again. Everything you stack now carries over to the main token later.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
